summary: Install PLATE docs under docs/plate/ when target repo has product docs, preventing collision with adopter documentation trees.
migration_impact: When importing PLATE into a repo that already has non-PLATE files under docs/, all PLATE documentation (design/, wiki/, research/, audits/, migration/, bootstrap/, marketing/, adr/, and root docs files) will install under docs/plate/ instead of the docs root. References in AGENTS.md, workflows, issue templates, and payload docs themselves are rewritten automatically. Root files docs/README.md and docs/playwright-e2e-guide.md count as PLATE only when their content matches the template markers, so a product README at that path triggers namespacing and is not overwritten. Explicit --namespace-docs / --no-namespace-docs (CLI) and namespace_docs (MCP plate_import_payload; omit to auto-detect) are wired through. The migration guide ships in the template payload at docs/migration/namespace-docs-migration.md.
migration_guidance: 1. Review the comprehensive migration guide at docs/migration/namespace-docs-migration.md.
2. For automatic migration: run 'gh plate import-payload --namespace-docs --strategy force --apply' to re-import with namespace.
3. For manual migration: move PLATE subdirs with 'git mv docs/{adr,audits,bootstrap,design,marketing,migration,research,wiki} docs/plate/' and update references.
4. Update doc references in AGENTS.md, workflows, issue templates using search commands in migration guide.
5. Update wiki sync workflows to use docs/plate/wiki/ instead of docs/wiki/.
6. Verify migration using checklist in migration guide.
7. For edge cases (mixed trees, customized wikis, open PRs, CI workflows), see dedicated sections in migration guide.
agent_notes: When importing PLATE payload, use auto-detect (namespace_docs=None) unless user explicitly requests always-namespace or never-namespace. Treat docs/plate/ as the canonical location for PLATE scaffolding docs when namespacing is active. Update any agent prompts or skills that hard-code docs/ paths to check for both docs/ and docs/plate/ variants, or use should_namespace_docs() + namespace_docs_path() helpers from payload_surface. Direct existing installations to docs/migration/namespace-docs-migration.md for migration steps.
